title: Square planar vs. pyramidal copper(II)-complexes with benzylal vs. naphthylal-based Schiff bases
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,18358-18371
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01982F, Paper

Mohammed Enamullah, Imdadul Haque, Amina Khan Resma, Galib Abdullah, Md. Najem Uddin, Takin Haj Hassani Sohi, Dennis Woschko, Peter Ferber, Christoph Janiak
Copper(II) complexes 1–3 feature variable geometries from square-planar (1) to distorted square-planar (2) and to square-pyramidal (3) as a function of benzylal- vs. naphthylal-based Schiff bases.
